title: BIOmarkers Before and After Kidney Transplantation
official: Diagnostic and PROgnostic BIOmarkers Before and After Kidney Transplantation
summary: In clinical nephrology, the search for urinary, blood and tissue biomarkers of specific kidney diseases is an important goal. In recent years, the use of these biomarkers has made it possible to diagnose many renal diseases that affect the native kidney. In some cases, biomarkers may be useful in determining the evolutionary profile of the disease and thus the most appropriate therapeutic management.

interventions.name: Blood sample during native kidney biopsy
Blood sample during renal graft biopsy
Urine sample during renal graft biopsy
Urine sample during native kidney biopsy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient hospitalised for renal biopsy of a native kidney or for renal transplantation
* Age \>18 years
* Informed and consented
* Covered by a social security scheme

Exclusion criteria:

* Patients under guardianship, conservatorship or legal protection
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Patient deprived of liberty
* Patients of legal age who are unable to give consent
